cases.title: Scenario 01
cases.reviewTask: Review the candidate change. Find introduced defects that violate the stated contract. Report only findings with a concrete trigger and evidence.
cases.spec: The `limit` query parameter accepts finite numbers. Values below 1 clamp to 1, values above 100 clamp to 100, and non-finite values use 20.

cases.title: Scenario 02
cases.reviewTask: Review the candidate change for correctness and trust-boundary violations. Report only findings with a concrete trigger and evidence.
cases.spec: Only roles attached to the authenticated user may authorize deletion. Request headers are attacker-controlled.

cases.title: Scenario 03
cases.reviewTask: Review the candidate change for security and regression risks. Report only findings with a concrete trigger and evidence.
cases.spec: `attachmentPath(root, name)` accepts one file name and must return a path under `root`. Callers pass untrusted upload names.

cases.title: Scenario 04
cases.reviewTask: Review the candidate change for lifecycle and concurrency regressions. Report only findings with a concrete trigger and evidence.
cases.spec: After `close()` is called, `receive()` must not enqueue another message, even while asynchronous socket shutdown is pending.

cases.title: Scenario 05
cases.reviewTask: Review the candidate change for correctness and regression risks. Report only findings with a concrete trigger and evidence.
cases.spec: A successful `update()` makes the next `get()` return the new configuration value.

cases.title: Scenario 06
cases.reviewTask: Review the candidate change. Report only introduced defects that violate the stated contract. Report only findings with a concrete trigger and evidence.
cases.spec: `renderTitle()` returns an HTML heading and must render arbitrary title text as text, not markup.

cases.title: Scenario 07
cases.reviewTask: Review the candidate change. Report only introduced defects that violate the stated contract. Report only findings with a concrete trigger and evidence.
cases.spec: Preserve `formatName()` output while retaining the issue text in a source comment for the support team.

cases.title: Scenario 08
cases.reviewTask: Review the candidate delivery against its acceptance criteria, including its claimed validation. Report only findings with a concrete trigger and evidence.
cases.spec: A delivery must either include the exact validation command and its result or explicitly state that validation was not run. A bare success claim is insufficient.
